RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the May 16, 2002/Vaisakha 26, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Coal and Mines; Communications and Information Technology;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; External Affairs;
Labour; Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances
and Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation)
————
Total number of questions—155
1146
Agro Export Zones
5246. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of Agro Export Zones
set up in different parts of the country;
State-wise;
(b) whether there is any proposal before
Government for setting up of more Agro
Export Zones; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
New Agro and Rural Industries Policy
5247. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to formulate a
new Agro and Rural Industries policy
considering the recent changes in the
economic liberalisation and globalisation;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Development of cottage industries in
Andhra Pradesh
5248. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any action
plan or package for development of cottage
industries in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the present status of the cottage
industries in the State?
Electricity generation from atomic
technology
†5249. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the news-item captioned
"Achcchi Va Sasti Bijli Milegi Pramanu
Praudyogiki Se" published in the Rashtriya
Sahara dated the 25th March, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction
thereto;

taken by Government with regard to the
setting up of a atomic power plant; and
(d) the target of generating power
therefrom?
MoU by Indian Rare Earths Ltd.
5250. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Rare Earths Ltd.
(IREL), has signed a Memorandum of
Understanding with a private company
(Kerala Rare Earths Ltd.) to have a joint
venture in mining and mineral separation of
Beach sand mineral at Chavara, Kollam
District;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the latest position of the said
joint venture proposal?
Satellite imagery to Map and Prospect
diamonds
5251. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether statellite imagery is being
used to map and prospect diamonds in the
country;
(b) if so, the States where work is being
done;
(c) the companies which are engaged in
this work; and
(d) the result of diamonds prospecting
during the last three years?
Growth rate in mining sector
5252. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the growth rate in mining
sector has been lower in April—February,
2001-02 as compared to the same months
in the year 2000-01;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
Amendment to contract labour laws
pertaining to coal mining sector
5253. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee on Integrated
Coal Policy has suggested amendments to
the Contract Labour Laws pertaining to coal
mining sector;
(b) if so, whether the recommendations
have been implemented/being implemented;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Committee to look into the affairs of
CIL and BCCL
5254. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR  AGARWALLA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether any Committee was set up
in 1993 to look into the affairs of Coal India
Ltd. and BCCL, Dhanbad and other related
issues of coal, its resources etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the major findings of the Committee;
(d) whether in 1994 Chairman, Coal
India Ltd. was asked to take action on the
findings of the Committee;
(e) if so, the action taken thereon; and
(f) the reasons for not taking any action
against BCCL, Dhanbad and its officials as
well?

Bogus industries availing Government
benefits
5255. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR  AGARWALLA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bogus industries under
the Ministry of Coal are illegally availing
the benefits of the scheme launched by
Government to encourage the industries and
are getting coal at price less than the market
price;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the amount swindled off by these
industries and the loss
